name: [Helios] Medallion Lakeflow Pipeline
description: Automated Medallion architecture Lakeflow Job orchestrating Bronze Ingestion (Module 6), Schema Inference (Module 7), Silver Cleaning (Module 9), Gold Dimensions/Facts (Module 10), and Platform Notifications. Features a manual gate awaiting Admin confirmation (Module 8) and repair-run support for stage retries (Module 12).

tasks.description: Runs Module 6 raw ingestion logic. Reads raw CSV, Excel, DB replica, or streaming payloads and persists immutable raw records into bronze Delta tables.
Runs Module 7 schema inference engine. Analyzes Bronze column signatures, detects types, scores similarity against templates, persists in inferred_schema, and sets status to 'awaiting_confirmation'.
Runs Module 9 Silver cleaning pipeline post-confirmation. Performs currency normalization, date standardization, deduplication, and null handling. Quarantined records logged to meta.data_quality_log.
Executes Module 10 master orchestration procedure helios.gold.sp_run_gold_pipeline to populate dimensions, fact tables, and rollups.
Dispatches a completion notification into platform.notification_log alerting SMB Owners that their dashboard is ready to view.

sql_task.statement: INSERT INTO helios.platform.notification_log (tenant_id, user_id, message, type, is_read, created_at) VALUES (CAST(:tenant_id AS BIGINT), NULL, 'Your dashboard is ready to view', 'pipeline_success', false, current_timestamp());

tasks.description: Executes if any upstream task fails. Records an error alert in platform.notification_log and preserves exact failing stage in meta.etl_audit_log.

sql_task.statement: INSERT INTO helios.platform.notification_log (tenant_id, user_id, message, type, is_read, created_at) VALUES (CAST(:tenant_id AS BIGINT), NULL, CONCAT('Pipeline failure encountered for batch ', :batch_id, '. Downstream execution was halted. Review Pipeline Health in the Admin Portal for diagnostics.'), 'error', false, current_timestamp());
